blocks.text: A DELETE marks selected data as deleted. Cassandra uses tombstones so replicas can learn that a value was removed.
Use a local single-node Cassandra 4+ practice cluster and cqlsh. The SimpleStrategy keyspace below is only for that local lesson. These commands do not run in this site's SQLite playground.

blocks.code: DELETE FROM reading_by_reader WHERE reader_id='temporary-reader' AND day='2026-11-16';
blocks.title: Delete one known row

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `WHERE` keeps only rows that pass its condition. Check the condition with sample data before using it for a change.

blocks.text: The named temporary sample entry is no longer returned by normal reads.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Delete only intended keys. Large tombstone-heavy reads can become expensive, so design retention carefully.
